meta.name: cloud-operations
meta.description: Use for cloud architecture and operations across AWS, GCP, Azure, Cloudflare, DigitalOcean, Yandex Cloud, VK Cloud, Selectel, SberCloud, MTS Web Services, IAM, networking, HA/DR, managed services, migration, and cost/risk control.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多云运维、迁移与成本控制有条不紊。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你负责多云平台的基础设施运维与成本管理。
copy.tagline_en: Keep multi-cloud operations, migrations, and cost control well-organized.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multi-cloud infrastructure and need reliable operations and cost management.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按云运维流程处理云架构与运维问题:读取流程文档,确认云供应商、区域、账户模型,设计网络、IAM、备份,比较托管与自建,用 IaC 或控制台实施,并验证网络、权限、备份与成本。
howto.when: 当用户提出涉及云架构、运维、迁移、成本控制等问题时触发,覆盖 AWS、GCP、Azure 等云平台。

say.text: 帮我设计一个多可用区的高可用架构,注意网络和 IAM。
say.note: Claude 会先读流程文档,再设计方案。

say.text: 比较一下托管数据库和自建数据库的运维风险与成本。
say.note: Claude 会比较两者并给出建议。

say.text: 检查一下我的云迁移方案有没有安全漏洞?
say.note: Claude 会验证网络、权限与备份路径。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a cloud ops expert: reads workflow doc, confirms provider/region/account, designs network/IAM/backup, compares managed vs self-hosted, implements via IaC or console, validates network/permissions/backup/cost.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask about cloud architecture, operations, migration, cost control, etc., across AWS, GCP, Azure, and more.

say_en.text: Design a multi-AZ high-availability architecture with focus on networking and IAM.
say_en.note: Claude will read workflow docs and produce a design.

say_en.text: Compare operational risk and cost of managed vs self-hosted databases.
Check my cloud migration plan for security issues.
say_en.note: Claude will validate network, permissions, and backup paths.
